name: MARRIOTT INTL A  DL-,01
summary: Marriott International, Inc. is a leading global hospitality firm managing, franchising, and licensing hotels, residential units, and timeshare resorts under brands including JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, W Hotels, Sheraton, and Westin. Established in 1927, Marriott International maintains its corporate headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland.
